Studio adds a faster terrain editor

By A. Writer, October 12, 2026

The October Studio update replaces the terrain brush with a faster editor that previews changes before they are applied. Creators can now sculpt large areas without the frame drops reported in earlier versions.

The release notes say the new editor is enabled by default for every place, and the old tools remain available for one more month.

What changes for scripts

  • Terrain:FillBlock is unchanged.
  • A new preview event fires before each edit.
